name: rung0_delta_reproducibility
claim: Rung 0 replicate ceiling, CORRECTLY pinned to rung 1's 14,121-gene Check-1 panel (job 31676846, first correctly-panelled run -- the prior 0.299/0.461 numbers were computed on a different, unpinned top-2000-HVG panel and cannot denominate rung 1). On the real panel the ceiling is much lower: split-half median 0.109, Spearman-Brown full-data 0.197, both clearing their diff_drug and same_drug nulls (p=0.0005). NOTE for the write-up: rung 1's baselines (knn/pca/nmf, mean_rho 0.28-0.32) numerically EXCEED this ceiling -- expected because rung 0 uses median aggregation and Pearson while rung 1 uses mean aggregation, per the documented (not yet reconciled) invariant-2/invariant-3 mismatch; do not report a 'fraction of ceiling' for rung 1 until that is resolved, a raw comparison is misleading here.
